gloss: backup power source; emergency power supply

definitions.gloss: backup power source; emergency power supply
definitions.explanation: A secondary power source that activates when the main power supply fails, such as generators, battery packs, or UPS systems, used in buildings, hospitals, data centers, and for disaster preparedness.

examples.japanese: {予備電源|よびでんげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おく。
examples.english: Keep a backup power source secured.

examples.japanese: ⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予備電源|よびでんげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自動的|じどうてき}→自動的：25589_jidouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}わる→切り替わる：28245_kirikawaru⟧。
examples.english: During a power outage, it automatically switches to the backup power source.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{予備電源|よびでんげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧な⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧{付|づ}けられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Hospitals are required to conduct regular inspections of backup power supplies for patient safety.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{予備|よび}→予備：03993_yobi⟧ (reserve; backup) and ⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧ (power source; power supply). Disaster preparedness is a major concern in Japan, making {予備電源|よびでんげん} a commonly discussed topic in both institutional and household contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予備電源|よびでんげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to secure a backup power source
- {予備電源|よびでんげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}わる→切り替わる：28245_kirikawaru⟧: to switch to backup power
- {予備電源|よびでんげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧: inspection of backup power
- {予備電源|よびでんげん}⟦{装置|そうち}→装置：03318_souchi⟧: backup power device

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {非常用電源|ひじょうようでんげん}: emergency power supply (emphasizes emergency use)
- {無停電電源装置|むていでんでんげんそうち}: uninterruptible power supply (UPS)
- {自家発電|じかはつでん}: private power generation, using one's own generator
- ⟦モバイルバッテリー→モバイルバッテリー：07553_mobairubatterii⟧: portable battery / power bank (for personal devices)
